schema.encoding: plain JSON, one combined file (fetch once client-side)
schema.source: NSE 'Bonds Traded in Capital Market' (api/liveBonds-traded-on-cm), refreshed daily after market close
schema.filter: credit rating A- or better; estimated yield to maturity > 10% and <= 30% (see bond_sources.py for why the upper bound exists)

bond.symbol: NSE trading symbol for this bond series
bond.creditRatingTier: AAA | AA | A (modifiers like + / - collapsed to the tier)
bond.creditRatingRaw: the raw NSE rating string, possibly multiple agencies
bond.estimatedYieldPercent: APPROXIMATE yield to maturity computed from price/coupon/face value/maturity — not NSE's own bYield field, which this feed leaves empty. Not a precise IRR; see bond_sources.py's estimate_ytm_percent for the formula.
